questions.question: Among five persons — P, Q, R, S, and T: P is taller than only T. Q is taller than P but shorter than R. S is the tallest. Who is the shortest?
questions.questionHtml:
Among five persons — P, Q, R, S, and T:
P is taller than only T.
Q is taller than P but shorter than R.
S is the tallest.
Who is the shortest?
questions.solution:
Given:

P is taller than only T → T is shortest among P and T

Q is taller than P but shorter than R → R > Q > P

S is the tallest → S > all

Final order from tallest to shortest: S > R > Q > P > T

Answer: T is the shortest

questions.question: Five persons are sitting in a straight line facing north. S is second to the left of T. R is to the immediate right of T. U sits to the Left of T but not at either end. Who is sitting in the middle?
questions.questionHtml: Five persons are sitting in a straight line facing north. S is second to the left of T. R is to the immediate right of T. U sits to the Left of T but not at either end. Who is sitting in the middle?
questions.solution:
Solution:

T is placed at position 3.

S is second to the left of T → position 1.

R is immediate right of T → position 4.

U is left of T and not at end → position 2.

Remaining V at position 5.

Final arrangement: S – U – T – R – (empty/unknown person)

questions.solution:
_ _ D C _ _ _

Seats are numbered left→right 1–7. D is 3rd from the left ⇒ D at position 3 . C is immediately right of D ⇒ C at position 4 . To the right of C are positions 5, 6, 7 ⇒ 3 people .
